input.quote: Charges for applicable Services will be specified in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms. Charges can be specified as one-time, installment, recurring, or usage. IBM will invoice such Charges when they begin or are due as set forth in Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: No minimum purchase, take-or-pay, shortfall or volume-commitment obligation is imposed on Customer anywhere in the Base Terms. Section 4.1 ties Charges solely to the Services actually ordered under Order Forms and Service Option Attachments (one-time, installment, recurring or usage), and Section 11.5 (Capacity Planning) leaves capacity increases entirely to Customer's determination and request rather than committing Customer to any volume. Customer also retains a monthly convenience exit under Section 3.4 and a no-charge exit on price/terms changes under Section 13.1, so there is no multi-year take-or-pay exposure. This meets the preferred position (no minimum commitment; fees for usage or ordered Services only), so no redline is proposed. Two points to note rather than flag: Section 3.4(b) preserves "early termination charges, if any" specified in Attachment A and Service Option Attachments (a T4C/exit-cost point, addressed under that rule), and any committed volumes or minimum monthly charges could still be introduced in an Order Form or Service Option Attachment not included in these Base Terms — we should confirm those documents contain no minimums before signature.
